summary: Completed backend + UI verification for Payment Gateway settings storage flow (Stripe/PayPal), including masking, persistence, toggle save, and state restoration.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/payment-gateway/settings returns masked payload only (`secret_key_configured` / `client_secret_configured`) and does not expose raw secrets.
PATCH /api/payment-gateway/settings persists provider fields via Mongo update and keeps Stripe/PayPal namespaces independent (PayPal update does not erase Stripe fields).
Blank secret input is ignored when submitted alongside non-secret updates (verified for PayPal client_secret), preserving previously stored secret values.
seed_data_creation: No long-lived seed data created. Payment gateway toggle change was restored to original value during UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Targeted payment-gateway regression now includes blank PayPal secret non-overwrite behavior in /app/backend/tests/test_payment_gateway_settings.py. UI test validated Stripe/PayPal Configure panels, Stripe Apple Pay toggle persistence, and explicit restoration.
rca of the issue: No defect reproduced in this iteration. Flow operates as settings-storage only; no Stripe/PayPal provider HTTP calls were observed during UI interactions.
